title: Letta / MemGPT — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Packer et al. describe it. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); empty lanes mean the paper defines no such step.
source: Packer et al. 2023/2024, MemGPT (arXiv:2310.08560v2, 13pp)  ·  txt: = pdftotext -layout (1000 lines); libtxt: = local library copy (1473 lines, no -layout) — two incompatible line-number systems, see servers/letta/verification.md header  ·  verified against servers/letta/verification.md (56 paper-side assertions, 48 ✓ / 2 ✗ / 6 ◐)
legend_notes: B3 EXPAND / B4 APPRAISE / B5 SELECT are all empty: recall_storage.search() and archival_storage.search() are undocumented black boxes — no algorithm, no reranking, no top-k rule, no expansion is ever given (P30).

B8 LOOP is filled while B5 SELECT is empty — MemGPT sits at the 'multi-pass' extreme of the retrieval architecture split (SKELETON §4④): zero combinatorial selection, but an unbounded heartbeat chain with no documented step cap or safety valve (P48, full-text grep = 0 hits).

A4 INDEX's only exercised instance is the offline Wikipedia precompute (W0) run before the experiments start — the LLM-triggered archival_storage.insert() described in §2.2 is never walked by any reported experiment (P22, P45).
